intro: One piece of boiled tapioca (about 100g) has about 160 kcal (estimate). Almost all the calories come from starch, which is carbs.
diet: Yes, you can. Boiled tapioca is a carb source like rice. One piece is about the same as 3/4 cup of rice. So if you eat tapioca, reduce your rice at the same time. What usually makes the calories shoot up is the grated coconut, sugar and sambal.
tips: If you have tapioca at tea time, reduce your rice at dinner.
Pair it with a boiled egg or dry-fried ikan bilis for extra protein.
Dip in a little grated coconut without sugar, or just a pinch of salt.

swap.name: Boiled sweet potato, 1 small
swap.why: Fewer calories, more fibre and vitamin A, with a natural sweet taste.

faq.q: Must tapioca be cooked until really soft?
faq.a: Yes. Raw tapioca has natural compounds that aren't good for the body. Peel, soak and boil until soft before eating.
Yes, once in a while. It's also a carb, just lower in protein, so pair it with a protein dish.

faq.q: Why does tapioca sometimes taste bitter?
faq.a: Some types of tapioca are naturally more bitter. Choose fresh ones and remove the skin and the middle vein before boiling.
